text:
Monica: Heads-up — Acme stuck with a Private VPC pilot ask. They expect ~72 concurrent generation sessions, ~1.1 requests/sec per session, avg response ~700 tokens. Sales wants a concise GPU-hour estimate + recommended pool plan for a Dedicated private deployment. Any quick backs-of-envelope or red flags?

Sophie: Need to give procurement 3 options (performance, balanced, cost-saver). Also call out networking & ops overhead.

Raj: Do we know target model? Contract lists open-llm-13b-8k but they may test a trimmed 7B. Performance differs a lot.

Lee: Quick calc (ballpark):
```
concurrency = 72
rps_per_session = 1.1
total_rps = 72 * 1.1 = 79.2 RPS
avg_tokens = 700
tokens_per_sec = 79.2 * 700 = 55,440 TPS
tokens_per_hour = 55,440 * 3600 = 199,584,000 tokens/hr
```
Assume modern GPU (H100-class) median sustained with batching ~6M tokens/hr for 13B quantized. So raw throughput => ~33 GPUs. But latency SLO, batching windows, KV reuse, and tail noise change that widely.

Anna: Important to present levers to Acme: short list — 1) session multiplexing / lower effective concurrency, 2) prefix/KV caching for system prompts, 3) hybrid routing to distilled 7B for ~20% of boilerplate traffic, 4) edge/regional pools to cut cross-AZ egress.

Monica: Ops wants an SKU recommendation and monthly GPU-hour + cost band. Can someone sketch conservative vs balanced vs optimized?

Lee: Conservative (performance-first): baseline 24 H100 GPUs (canary + steady), autoscale ceiling 48 GPUs. Monthly GPU-hours: 24*24*30 = 17,280 baseline. Assume average autoscale adds 10 GPUs for 4 hours/day => 10*4*30 = 1,200. Total ~18,480 GPU-hrs/month. At cloud H100 $6–$9/hr => $111k–$166k/mo (cloud list rates).

Lee: Balanced: baseline 16 H100 GPUs, autoscale to 36. Baseline hours = 16*24*30 = 11,520. Autoscale avg +8 GPUs * 5h/day = 8*5*30 = 1,200. Total ~12,720 GPU-hrs/month => $76k–$115k/mo. Use mixed routing to 7B for ~20% to reduce token pressure.

Anna: Cost-saver (latency-tolerant): baseline 8 GPUs, autoscale to 24, heavy caching & routing (~30% to 7B). Baseline hrs = 8*24*30 = 5,760. Autoscale avg +8 GPUs * 3h/day = 720. Total ~6,480 GPU-hrs/month => $39k–$58k/mo. Note: p95 latency will be higher due to batching/coalescing.

Raj: Network + infra overhead: recommend adding ~8–12% headroom for regional redundancy (hot/cold pools) if user base spans regions. Also include NVMe workspace for KV caches and an NLB per region. Cross-AZ egress costs may apply when routing fallback crosses zones.

ops-bot: [perf-log] internal benchmark: 13B-q8 on H100 sustained median ~6.0M tokens/hr/GPU with batching; 95th drops ~20–30% on noisy aggregates. Quantization + prompt structure ±25% effect.

Lee: Operational recommendations: pre-warm a small pool during business hours, tune autoscale cooldowns (120–300s), set a hard max to avoid runaway spend, enable per-model KV caching, and instrument per-route token burn and p95.

Sophie: Sales needs a 1-sheet: bullets for each option, GPU-hour table (we have it above), rough cost bands, and five mandatory ops notes (networking, autoscale caps, KV caching enablement, regional pools, monitoring & alerts). Can someone draft and dump in #eng-infra for quick review?

Anna: I'll assemble the 1-sheet. Tagging @Raj and @Lee to validate perf assumptions and add an explicit +/- variance (we should call out ~30% uncertainty depending on token distro & quantization).

Raj: ACK. I'll run a quick perf sweep on the internal harness for 13B vs 7B quantized configs and post numbers by EOD.

Monica: Great — having that before tomorrow's procurement call would be ideal. Thanks all.
